classification.better-candidate-existed: some mask already recorded for this cover (any phrasing, any pointer) satisfies the predicate while the shipped `plain` mask does not, AND that mask is a single point-grown mask. The reachable set contained the answer and the policy did not take it.
classification.multi-region-ground: no single recorded mask satisfies the predicate, but the union of the admissible recorded masks does. One point cannot cover this ground; several can.
classification.no-good-candidate: neither any single recorded mask nor their union satisfies the predicate. On the recorded evidence this is not reachable by point prompting at all.
classification.note: `better-candidate-existed` is scoped to the recorded set, which is point-level, not decoder-candidate-level. It therefore proves reachability, not that the four candidates from the shipped point contained the answer.

policy_under_test.name: SELECT_GROUND + union_ground
policy_under_test.band_rationale: A mask covering more than 85% of the frame cannot be the ground of a cover that has a subject — it has swallowed the subject. A mask under 5% is a detail, not a field. Both bounds are set from the shape of the failure, not from a sweep, and neither is fitted to a score.
policy_under_test.SELECT_GROUND: over the decoder's K candidates: among those containing every foreground point AND inside the band, take the LARGEST by area. If none is in band, take the largest containing candidate below max. If none contains the points, fall back to the incumbent SELECT_CONTAINING behaviour. RATIONALE, and it is a mechanism argument not a measurement: SAM's multimask head emits a nested part/sub-object/whole-object family, and argmax-predicted-IoU on this path is measured (2.4) to rank candidates poorly, so ranking by area inside a plausibility band replaces a bad ranker with a prior rather than with another bad ranker.
policy_under_test.union_ground: given several points on one cover, segment from each, drop inadmissible masks, union the rest. If the union exceeds max_area_fraction, return the largest admissible single mask instead of the union.
policy_under_test.what_is_evaluated_offline: union_ground only, over the recorded per-phrasing masks. SELECT_GROUND cannot be evaluated without the unstored candidates.
